title: Pūtōrino vs Didgeridoo (NZ AUS Respect Rap Off)
style: ultra high-energy progressive synth pop house festival mainstage banger, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy with massive euphoric drops and huge builds. Main foundation is dense wordless vocal production only: human voices and bots mimic all instruments (shimmering supersaw leads, rolling deep sub basslines, arpeggios, stabs, crisp claps, snares, pads AND heavy booming 808 bass thump created with mouth/throat/breath). Second voice delivers deep resonant Australian didgeridoo drones with circular breathing, growls, overtones PLUS powerful Māori pūtōrino bugle flute (dual male trumpet + female melodic voice tones). Constant driving vocal percussion as background instrument the entire track using the exact lick doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss. Two real singers (warm confident male baritone + bright energetic soulful female) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases, lush harmonies and ad-libs only so the rich wordless vocal layer
